summary: This htaccess configuration sets up HTTP Basic Authentication (a username/password login prompt) for a specific file called confidential.md. It tells the web server to look up user credentials from a password file and only allow authenticated users to access that file.

explanations.1: AuthName is the message shown in the browser's login popup dialog — it tells users why they need to log in.
explanations.3: AuthUserFile points to the actual password file on the server that contains the list of valid usernames and encrypted passwords.
explanations.5: The <Files> directive means the authentication rules inside only apply to files matching that pattern — in this case, just the confidential.md file.
explanations.6: Require valid-user is the actual permission rule: it says only users who have successfully logged in (provided valid credentials) can access this file.
